official_runtime_docs.description: vLLM supported speculative decoding algorithms: EAGLE, MTP, Draft Model, PARD, MLP, N-Gram, Suffix. Verified 2026-05-17.

official_runtime_docs.name: NVIDIA: Introducing NVFP4 for Efficient and Accurate Low-Precision Inference
official_runtime_docs.description: Primary vendor source for NVFP4 format: 16-value blocks with a shared FP8 E4M3 scale plus per-tensor FP32, vs MXFP4's 32-value power-of-two-scaled blocks.

official_runtime_docs.name: NVIDIA Transformer Engine: NVFP4 block scaling reference
official_runtime_docs.description: Implementation-level NVFP4 two-level block-scaling documentation.

official_runtime_docs.name: Red Hat Developer: Accelerating LLMs with NVFP4 quantization (2026-02-04)
official_runtime_docs.description: Measured NVFP4 accuracy recovery by model size (~99% at 70B-235B, 97-99% at ~30B, ~95-98% at 7B-14B) and weight-storage reduction vs BF16/FP8.

routing_and_control_planes.name: vLLM Production Stack
routing_and_control_planes.description: Reference cluster stack for vLLM with Helm-based K8s deployment, model/prefix-aware routing, and LMCache KV offloading. The URL moved from blog.vllm.ai/production-stack/ (which 404s) to docs.vllm.ai/projects/production-stack/ under the main docs site.

routing_and_control_planes.name: NVIDIA vLLM Release Notes

routing_and_control_planes.name: Dynamo (open-source, Apache 2.0)
routing_and_control_planes.description: Open-source multi-cloud inference orchestration. Supports AWS EKS, GKE. Used by Moonshot AI, Mistral AI, Baseten, Alibaba. Apache 2.0. Verified 2026-05-17.

routing_and_control_planes.name: LMCache
routing_and_control_planes.description: Open-source KV cache Knowledge Delivery Network. CPU DRAM KV offload, integrates with vLLM and TGI. V1 compatibility: verify at github.com/LMCache/LMCache. Verified 2026-05-17.

routing_and_control_planes.name: vLLM Semantic Router Iris
routing_and_control_planes.description: Current vLLM routing layer focused on model routing, safety, and semantic caching.

routing_and_control_planes.name: llm-d Quick Start
routing_and_control_planes.description: Entry point for llm-d deployment and operational model.

routing_and_control_planes.name: llm-d Architecture Overview
routing_and_control_planes.description: Kubernetes-native distributed inference architecture with KV-aware routing and disaggregation.

routing_and_control_planes.name: llm-d Inference Router Architecture
routing_and_control_planes.description: Routing signals, scorers, and phase-aware scheduling architecture.

routing_and_control_planes.name: llm-d Precise Prefix Cache Aware Routing
routing_and_control_planes.description: Concrete guide for KV-events based prefix-aware scheduling.

routing_and_control_planes.name: Pai — Designing Large Language Model Applications (ch. 13)
routing_and_control_planes.description: O'Reilly 2025. Chapter 13 covers multi-LLM architectures: LLM cascades and the taxonomy of escalation confidence signals (calibrated output probabilities for encoder models, self-consistency, margin sampling per Ramirez et al.), plus routers and task-specialized LLMs. Source of the warning against asking an LLM to state its own confidence (pp. 631-633).

foundational_papers.name: vLLM: Easy and Fast LLM Serving with PagedAttention
foundational_papers.description: Foundational paper for KV-cache-aware serving and paging.

foundational_papers.name: Orca: A Distributed Serving System for Transformer-Based Generative Models

foundational_papers.name: EAGLE: Speculative Sampling Requires Rethinking Feature Uncertainty

foundational_papers.name: Medusa: Simple LLM Inference Acceleration Framework
DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report (MTP)
foundational_papers.description: DeepSeek-V3 architecture including native Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) heads.

foundational_papers.name: Mixtral MoE Architecture Reference
foundational_papers.description: Mixtral MoE architecture paper for expert parallelism context.

foundational_papers.name: Bridging the Gap Between Promise and Performance for Microscaling FP4 Quantization (MR-GPTQ, ICLR 2026)
foundational_papers.description: Micro-Rotated-GPTQ uses block-wise Hadamard transforms to bring MXFP4 accuracy near NVFP4.

foundational_papers.name: SOAR: Scale Optimization for Accurate Reconstruction in NVFP4 Quantization
foundational_papers.description: NVFP4 PTQ scale initialisation via closed-form joint scale optimization and decoupled scale search.

foundational_papers.name: ScaleSweep: Accurate NVFP4 PTQ of LLMs via Block Scale Initialization
foundational_papers.description: NVFP4 PTQ that sweeps feasible block-scale candidates; reports preserving >93% of full-precision performance under aggressive quantization.

foundational_papers.name: FP4 All the Way: Fully Quantized Training of LLMs
foundational_papers.description: First demonstration of fully quantized LLM training predominantly in FP4, with downstream performance comparable to a BF16 baseline at 7B.

observability_and_safety.name: OpenTelemetry Semantic Conventions for GenAI
observability_and_safety.description: Canonical telemetry vocabulary for request, token, and model metrics.

observability_and_safety.name: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
observability_and_safety.description: Security baseline for inference-facing applications and APIs.

architecture_and_attention_serving.name: SmoothQuant: Accurate and Efficient Post-Training Quantization for LLMs (Xiao et al. 2022)
architecture_and_attention_serving.description: Migrates quantization difficulty from activation outliers to weights via per-channel scaling — why W8A8 needs calibration and how it avoids the outlier-feature failure that breaks naive INT8 activations.

architecture_and_attention_serving.name: Efficient Streaming Language Models with Attention Sinks (Xiao et al. 2023)
architecture_and_attention_serving.description: StreamingLLM: keep sink tokens + a rolling recent window for fixed-memory effectively-infinite decoding; the canonical long-context serving workaround and its middle-context cost.

architecture_and_attention_serving.name: Ring Attention with Blockwise Transformers for Near-Infinite Context (Liu et al. 2023)
architecture_and_attention_serving.description: Sequence-parallel attention distributing KV across devices for >1M-token context; grounds the ring-attention long-context serving option.

architecture_and_attention_serving.name: Efficiently Scaling Transformer Inference (Pope et al. 2022)
architecture_and_attention_serving.description: Memory-bandwidth-bound decode vs compute-bound prefill, arithmetic-intensity / roofline analysis, and the batching-vs-latency tradeoff that the roofline section builds on.

architecture_and_attention_serving.name: Insights into DeepSeek-V3: Scaling Challenges and Hardware for AI (2025)
architecture_and_attention_serving.description: MLA KV-cache economics: DeepSeek-V3 ~70 KB/token vs ~192-328 KB/token for GQA models; 576-dim latent (512 KV + 64 decoupled RoPE). Source for the 2.7-4.7x reduction figures.

architecture_and_attention_serving.name: P-EAGLE: Parallel Speculative Decoding in vLLM (vLLM blog, 2026)
architecture_and_attention_serving.description: Parallel draft generation on top of EAGLE-3 (~1.05-1.69x over vanilla EAGLE-3), integrated into vLLM. Marker that EAGLE-3 is now production-standard, not a preview.

architecture_and_attention_serving.name: MoE Architecture Survey: Routing, Topology, Load Balancing, Expert Parallelism (Li, Aug 2026)
architecture_and_attention_serving.description: Five coupled MoE axes (granularity, topology, routing freedom, load-balancing scope, execution structure); source for the granularity-to-all-to-all cost coupling in moe-expert-parallelism.md.

architecture_and_attention_serving.name: LAER-MoE: Load-Adaptive Expert Re-layout (ASPLOS 2026)
architecture_and_attention_serving.description: Fully Sharded Expert Parallel (FSEP) re-lays out expert parameters in response to observed load; training-scoped, cited in the EPLB discussion.

architecture_and_attention_serving.name: DeepSeek-V4 preview release note (2026-04-24)
architecture_and_attention_serving.description: Primary source for DeepSeek-V4 Pro (1.6T total / 49B active) and Flash (284B total / 13B active) parameter counts.

architecture_and_attention_serving.name: DeepSeek-V4-Flash model card
architecture_and_attention_serving.description: Model card confirming 284B parameters (13B activated); does not state routed/shared expert counts.

gpu_node_and_cluster_tuning.name: Chris Fregly, AI Systems Performance Engineering (O'Reilly, Nov 2025), Ch 3: OS, Docker, and Kubernetes Tuning for GPU-Based Environments
gpu_node_and_cluster_tuning.description: Source for gpu-node-and-cluster-tuning.md: NUMA affinity resolution (NVML -> numactl), transparent hugepages throughput-vs-latency tradeoff, IRQ affinity, vm.swappiness, CPU governor/C-states, host allocator tuning, GPU persistence mode, MPS vs MIG isolation criteria and the MIG NVLink-P2P disable, clock locking / power limits / ECC, NVIDIA Container Toolkit driver-runtime split, PTX vs CUBIN forward compatibility, OverlayFS CoW overhead, GPU Operator + Feature Discovery topology labels, Topology Manager policies, NVLink-domain-aware allocation anti-pattern, RDMA device plugin and host networking, QoS=Guaranteed and OOM-killer tradeoffs, DCGM as fleet metrics layer. MIG profile tables and NVLink bandwidth figures in the book are generation-bound and are deliberately not carried into the reference.

pruning_and_sparsity.name: SparseGPT: Massive Language Models Can Be Accurately Pruned in One-Shot
pruning_and_sparsity.description: One-shot layer-wise reconstruction pruning; source of the 50%/60% sparsity and 2:4-4:8 generalisation claims.

pruning_and_sparsity.name: Wanda: A Simple and Effective Pruning Approach for Large Language Models
pruning_and_sparsity.description: Weights-times-input-activations importance metric, the central insight for why magnitude alone fails on LLMs.

pruning_and_sparsity.name: SlideSparse: Fast and Flexible (2N-2):2N Structured Sparsity
pruning_and_sparsity.description: Runs milder (2N-2):2N patterns on 2:4 Sparse Tensor Cores; source of the Qwen3 54%-to-15% collapse and the 1.33x compute-bound speedup.

pruning_and_sparsity.name: Compact Language Models via Pruning and Knowledge Distillation (Minitron)
pruning_and_sparsity.description: Depth/width/attention/MLP pruning plus distillation retraining on <3% of original data; 40x fewer tokens than training from scratch.

pruning_and_sparsity.name: LLM Pruning and Distillation in Practice: The Minitron Approach
pruning_and_sparsity.description: Depth vs joint width pruning comparison on Llama 3.1 8B and Mistral NeMo 12B.

pruning_and_sparsity.name: Sheared LLaMA: Accelerating Language Model Pre-training via Structured Pruning
pruning_and_sparsity.description: Targeted structured pruning with dynamic batch loading at 3% of from-scratch compute.

pruning_and_sparsity.name: DarwinLM: Evolutionary Structured Pruning of Large Language Models
pruning_and_sparsity.description: Evolutionary search over per-layer pruning ratios; 5x less post-compression training data than Sheared LLaMA.

pruning_and_sparsity.name: ShortGPT: Layers in LLMs are More Redundant Than You Expect
pruning_and_sparsity.description: Block Influence metric for depth-only layer removal; the cheapest structured-pruning baseline.

pruning_and_sparsity.name: Deja Vu: Contextual Sparsity for Efficient LLMs at Inference Time
pruning_and_sparsity.description: Defines contextual sparsity as input-dependent head/MLP subsets; >2x vs FasterTransformer.

pruning_and_sparsity.name: ReLU Strikes Back: Exploiting Activation Sparsity in Large Language Models
pruning_and_sparsity.description: ReLU as the activation choice that creates exploitable sparsity; up to 3x computation reduction.

pruning_and_sparsity.name: TEAL: Training-Free Activation Sparsity in Large Language Models
pruning_and_sparsity.description: Training-free magnitude activation sparsity; 40-50% model-wide with 1.53x/1.8x decode speedups.

pruning_and_sparsity.name: CATS: Contextually-Aware Thresholding for Sparsity in Large Language Models
pruning_and_sparsity.description: Contextual activation thresholding at 50% sparsity with a custom kernel giving ~15% token-generation latency improvement.

pruning_and_sparsity.name: Small LLMs: Pruning vs. Training from Scratch
pruning_and_sparsity.description: Anchor for the prune-vs-train-small decision section; pruning wins under limited token budget, from-scratch competitive when budget is unrestricted.

pruning_and_sparsity.name: Not All Experts are Equal: Efficient Expert Pruning and Skipping for MoE LLMs
pruning_and_sparsity.description: Post-training expert-level pruning/skipping for MoE, the hardware-independent MoE sparsity axis.

pruning_and_sparsity.name: NVIDIA: Accelerating Inference with Sparsity Using Ampere and TensorRT
pruning_and_sparsity.description: Authoritative statement of the 2:4 pattern and A100 Sparse Tensor Core support.

pruning_and_sparsity.name: NVIDIA Model Optimizer — Pruning guide
pruning_and_sparsity.description: Minitron/Puzzletron/FastNAS support, the axes Minitron prunes, and the recommended recovery fine-tuning recipe.

pruning_and_sparsity.name: LLM Compressor — Compression Schemes
pruning_and_sparsity.description: Verbatim 2026 notice that sparse compression including 2of4 is no longer supported (vLLM PR #36799).

expert_panel_aug_2026.name: Do Language Models Use Their Depth Efficiently? - Csordas et al.
expert_panel_aug_2026.description: Supplies the mechanism behind ShortGPT's depth-pruning 'redundancy': layers in the second half contribute much less to the residual stream than those in the first half, with a clear phase transition. Explains why low-Block-Influence blocks exist and are safe to delete.

expert_panel_aug_2026.name: LLM.int8(): 8-bit Matrix Multiplication for Transformers at Scale
expert_panel_aug_2026.description: Source for the outlier-channel failure mode and the mixed-precision decomposition that isolates outlier feature dimensions into 16-bit while >99.9% of values stay 8-bit.

expert_panel_aug_2026.name: AWQ: Activation-aware Weight Quantization for On-Device LLM Compression and Acceleration
expert_panel_aug_2026.description: Source for activation-aware per-channel scaling: salient weight channels selected from activation statistics, scaled by an equivalent transformation with no backprop or reconstruction.

expert_panel_aug_2026.name: QuaRot: Outlier-Free 4-Bit Inference in Rotated LLMs
expert_panel_aug_2026.description: Source for why rotations help 4-bit quantization: rotates LLMs to remove hidden-state outliers without changing the output, enabling end-to-end 4-bit weights, activations, and KV cache.

expert_panel_aug_2026.name: SpinQuant: LLM Quantization with Learned Rotations
expert_panel_aug_2026.description: Learned rather than fixed rotations; states directly that rotating activation or weight matrices removes outliers and benefits quantization, using output-invariant rotation parameterizations.

expert_panel_aug_2026.name: Auxiliary-Loss-Free Load Balancing Strategy for Mixture-of-Experts (DeepSeek, arXiv 2408.15664)
expert_panel_aug_2026.description: Defines MaxVio (maximal violation) and its global vs batch variants — the load-balance metric cited in the Routing Health Metrics section; also the source of bias-based (Loss-Free) balancing as distinct from auxiliary-loss balancing.
